mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL increases are not followed by tightening monetary policy within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous three months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decreases are not followed by increased corporate earnings within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous two months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances following HOUST increases, or HOUST increases are not correlated with increased economic activity within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS > 4% is not followed by a restrictive monetary policy within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points, signals a strengthening labor market and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combined increase in PAYEMS and decrease in UNRATE are not followed by economic growth within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decreases are not followed by a contraction in supply within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the previous three months signals increased consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances following RSAFS increases, or RSAFS increases are not correlated with increased consumer demand within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) decreases by more than 0.5% over the previous three months, coupled with an increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% over the previous six months, it signals accommodative monetary policy and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combined decrease in FEDFUNDS and increase in GDPC1 are not followed by economic growth within 6 months.
